links.outcome: Agreement of ChatGPT4 vs endoscopist recommendations with USMSTF guideline panel
links.effect: ChatGPT4 agreed with USMSTF Panel in 85.7% vs 75.4% for gastroenterology practice (P < .001).
links.quote: ChatGPT4 recommendations were in closer agreement with the USMSTF Panel (85.7%) than gastroenterology practice recommendations with the USMSTF Panel (75.4%) (P < .001).

links.outcome: Reference standard generated by expert panel using clinical information and guideline documents
links.effect: Reference standard (USMSTF Panel) was generated per case by an expert panel; the study did not test whether the practice affected results.
links.quote: The latter was generated for each case by an expert panel using the clinical information and guideline documents as reference.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of ChatGPT-4's accuracy in recommending colonoscopy surveillance intervals compared to endoscopist practice and expert guideline panels.
